question:
Create a new KiCad project named b04 in the project directory and draw its schematic for the following request.

Build a passive TSOP-48 socket adapter for the NANDO NAND programmer using the supplied TSOP-48_adapter, Conn_02x12_Odd_Even_Left and Conn_02x12_Odd_Even_Right symbols. The left socket has electrical pin numbers 1-24 and the right socket has electrical pin numbers 25-48, even though each socket physically has 24 contacts. Route each TSOP contact to the socket contact with the same electrical number. Preserve the supplied custom numbering; do not renumber the right socket 1-24. Use two 2x12, 2.54 mm sockets and no active circuitry.
Local dependencies: Use the project-local symbol library in lib/ under the project directory (nand_programmator.kicad_sym); use standard KiCad libraries for everything else.

Created the [b04 KiCad project](</home/modernmariner/Projects/Agentic AI for Circuit Design/EDA_Agent/eval/output/b04/run7/b04.kicad_pro>) and its passive TSOP-48 adapter schematic.

All 48 contacts connect to the same-numbered socket contacts; the right socket retains numbering 25–48. The supplied local symbols and footprints were used. **ERC passed with zero violations.**

Assumption: the supplied TSOP and socket footprints match the physical parts to be used. Verify their mechanical fit before fabrication. No PCB layout was created.
